details.report: Removed both Judge-identified test-only production APIs (`afterLedgerEvent` and ledger rename/cleanup injection). Replaced lifecycle crash probes with Recorder-owned invocation barriers and asserted exact selected/pre/post identities, durable recovered latestAttempt, one role launch, and one successful post-settlement consultation. Existing admission/end race and concurrent canonical publication proofs remain active. Gates passed: 425 tests (5 skipped), typecheck, build:recorder, npm pack --dry-run, and diff check. Ledger cleanup-causality injection test was removed with its forbidden API; no deterministic ordinary-filesystem setup was found that can force both publication and cleanup failures without adding a hook or altering production behavior.
